about: The commands the operator's desk suggests. emporia/operator_desk.py and dashboard/src/operatorCommands.ts both reproduce this table (tests/test_operator.py, dashboard/src/operatorCommands.test.ts).

expect.label: accept, severity high
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_0123456789abcdef accepted --severity high --fix FIX_COMMIT

expect.label: a duplicate
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_0123456789abcdef duplicate --of EARLIER_REPORT

expect.label: invalid
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_0123456789abcdef invalid

expect.label: accept, severity SEVERITY
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_aa accepted --severity SEVERITY --fix FIX_COMMIT

expect.label: a duplicate
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_aa duplicate --of EARLIER_REPORT

expect.label: invalid
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs opdesk verdict bug_aa invalid

expect.label: adopt
expect.command: hermes emporia ideas opdesk adopt pst_0123456789ab --ref COMMIT_OR_ROADMAP_ITEM

expect.label: noted
expect.command: hermes emporia ideas opdesk noted pst_0123456789ab

expect.label: a duplicate
expect.command: hermes emporia ideas opdesk duplicate pst_0123456789ab --of EARLIER_POST

expect.label: post this week's expedition
expect.command: hermes emporia operator opdesk expedition 'TITLE' --text 'WHAT TO TRY'

expect.label: start
expect.command: hermes emporia house start house-1

expect.label: stop
expect.command: hermes emporia house stop house-1

expect.label: its last pass
expect.command: hermes emporia house status house-1

expect.label: back up the relay's database
expect.command: hermes emporia operator opdesk snapshot

expect.label: accept, severity low
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs NAME verdict bug_aa accepted --severity low --fix FIX_COMMIT

expect.label: a duplicate
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs NAME verdict bug_aa duplicate --of EARLIER_REPORT

expect.label: invalid
expect.command: hermes emporia bugs NAME verdict bug_aa invalid

expect.label: read the lab's threads
expect.command: hermes emporia lab opdesk show emporia
